object: LLM-mediated scientific research workflow under matched model capability and evidence access
context: paired scientific task worlds stratified by evidence topology and evaluated under protected task-level scoring
population: fresh confirmatory scientific task worlds not used to design the architecture prompts or evaluator
primary_estimand: within-model within-evidence-access difference in valid scientific success and resource cost between each strong parent and RAKL_FIXED

task_set.blocking_reason: The repository contains task metadata but no task prompts, evidence payloads, hidden outcomes, or confirmatory split.

model.interface_type: Codex agent CLI with provider-managed system context rather than a neutral model API

excluded_from_primary_execution.RAKL_EVOLVING: Requires a separately frozen fresh-assurance transaction and cannot share this confirmatory evaluator.

resources.note: These ceilings are frozen for protocol v1 before outcome access; infeasibility requires a superseding packet before any evaluated result is opened.

mandatory_evidence_coverage_experiment.outcome: fraction of preregistered mandatory evidence identities present in active context
mandatory_evidence_coverage_experiment.secondary_outcome: valid_scientific_success at the same active-context token budget

evaluator.blocking_reason: The available evaluator scores structured process records but does not score final task correctness on a protected confirmatory corpus.

statistics.binary_contrasts: paired risk difference with task-level bootstrap interval; McNemar only after nondegenerate discordant counts
statistics.architecture_evidence_interaction: preregistered hierarchical model after confirmatory task count supports estimation
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across registered primary failure coordinates

result_access_policy: No evaluated result may be generated until a superseding packet passes preflight with all task, prompt, evidence, evaluator, provider, resource, seed, and price bindings present.
claim_boundary: This packet freezes an execution design and its current blockers. It contains no evaluated outcomes and supports no empirical comparative claim.
